verses.he: וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.en: Then Job answered and said:

verses.he: ל֗וּ שָׁק֣וֹל יִשָּׁקֵ֣ל כַּעְשִׂ֑י והיתי [וְ֝הַוָּתִ֗י] בְּֽמֹאזְנַ֥יִם יִשְׂאוּ־יָֽחַד׃
verses.en: Oh that my vexation were but weighed, And my calamity laid in the balances altogether!

verses.he: כִּֽי־עַתָּ֗ה מֵח֣וֹל יַמִּ֣ים יִכְבָּ֑ד עַל־כֵּ֝֗ן דְּבָרַ֥י לָֽעוּ׃
verses.en: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the seas; t Herefore are my words broken.

verses.he: כִּ֤י חִצֵּ֪י שַׁדַּ֡י עִמָּדִ֗י אֲשֶׁ֣ר חֲ֭מָתָם שֹׁתָ֣ה רוּחִ֑י בִּעוּתֵ֖י אֱל֣וֹהַּ יַֽעַרְכֽוּנִי׃
verses.en: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me, The poison whereof my spirit drinketh up; The terrors of God do set themselves in array against me.

verses.he: הֲיִֽנְהַק־פֶּ֥רֶא עֲלֵי־דֶ֑שֶׁא אִ֥ם יִגְעֶה־שּׁ֝֗וֹר עַל־בְּלִילֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Doth the wild ass bray when he hath grass? Or loweth the ox over his fodder?

verses.he: הֲיֵאָכֵ֣ל תָּ֭פֵל מִבְּלִי־מֶ֑לַח אִם־יֶשׁ־טַ֝֗עַם בְּרִ֣יר חַלָּמֽוּת׃
verses.en: Can that which hath no savour be eaten without salt? Or is there any taste in the juice of mallows?

verses.he: מֵאֲנָ֣ה לִנְגּ֣וֹעַ נַפְשִׁ֑י הֵ֝֗מָּה כִּדְוֵ֥י לַחְמִֽי׃
verses.en: My soul refuseth to touch them; They are as the sickness of my flesh.

verses.he: מִֽי־יִ֭תֵּן תָּב֣וֹא שֶֽׁאֱלָתִ֑י וְ֝תִקְוָתִ֗י יִתֵּ֥ן אֱלֽוֹהַּ׃
verses.en: Oh that I might have my request, And that God would grant me the thing that I long for! .

verses.he: וְיֹאֵ֣ל אֱ֭לוֹהַּ וִֽידַכְּאֵ֑נִי יַתֵּ֥ר יָ֝ד֗וֹ וִֽיבַצְּעֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: Even that it would please God to crush me; That He would let loose His hand, and cut me off!

verses.he: וּ֥תְהִי ע֨וֹד׀ נֶ֘חָ֤מָתִ֗י וַאֲסַלְּדָ֣ה בְ֭חִילָה לֹ֣א יַחְמ֑וֹל כִּי־לֹ֥א כִ֝חַ֗דְתִּי אִמְרֵ֥י קָדֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.en: Then should I yet have comfort; Yea, I would exult in pain, though He spare not; For I have not denied the words of the Holy One.

verses.he: מַה־כֹּחִ֥י כִֽי־אֲיַחֵ֑ל וּמַה־קִּ֝צִּ֗י כִּֽי־אַאֲרִ֥יךְ נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.en: What is my strength, that I should wait? And what is mine end, that I should be patient?

verses.he: אִם־כֹּ֣חַ אֲבָנִ֣ים כֹּחִ֑י אִֽם־בְּשָׂרִ֥י נָחֽוּשׁ׃
verses.en: Is my strength the strength of stones? Or is my flesh of brass?

verses.he: הַאִ֬ם אֵ֣ין עֶזְרָתִ֣י בִ֑י וְ֝תֻשִׁיָּ֗ה נִדְּחָ֥ה מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.en: Is it that I have no help in me, And that sound wisdom is driven quite from me?

verses.he: לַמָּ֣ס מֵרֵעֵ֣הוּ חָ֑סֶד וְיִרְאַ֖ת שַׁדַּ֣י יַעֲזֽוֹב׃
verses.en: To him that is ready to faint kindness is due from his friend, Even to him that forsaketh the fear of the Almighty.

verses.he: אַ֭חַי בָּגְד֣וּ כְמוֹ־נָ֑חַל כַּאֲפִ֖יק נְחָלִ֣ים יַעֲבֹֽרוּ׃
verses.en: My brethren have dealt deceitfully as a brook, As the channel of brooks that overflow,

verses.he: הַקֹּדְרִ֥ים מִנִּי־קָ֑רַח עָ֝לֵ֗ימוֹ יִתְעַלֶּם־שָֽׁלֶג׃
verses.en: Which are black by reason of the ice, And wherein the snow hideth itself;

verses.he: בְּ֭עֵת יְזֹרְב֣וּ נִצְמָ֑תוּ בְּ֝חֻמּ֗וֹ נִדְעֲכ֥וּ מִמְּקוֹמָֽם׃
verses.en: What time they wax warm, they vanish, When it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.

verses.he: יִ֭לָּ֣פְתוּ אָרְח֣וֹת דַּרְכָּ֑ם יַעֲל֖וּ בַתֹּ֣הוּ וְיֹאבֵֽדוּ׃
verses.en: The paths of their way do wind, They go up into the waste, and are lost.

verses.he: הִ֭בִּיטוּ אָרְח֣וֹת תֵּמָ֑א הֲלִיכֹ֥ת שְׁ֝בָ֗א קִוּוּ־לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.en: The caravans of Tema looked, The companies of Sheba waited for them—

verses.he: בֹּ֥שׁוּ כִּֽי־בָטָ֑ח בָּ֥אוּ עָ֝דֶ֗יהָ וַיֶּחְפָּֽרוּ׃
verses.en: They were ashamed because they had hoped; They came thither, and were confounded.

verses.he: כִּֽי־עַ֭תָּה הֱיִ֣יתֶם לא [ל֑וֹ] תִּֽרְא֥וּ חֲ֝תַ֗ת וַתִּירָֽאוּ׃
verses.en: For now ye are become His; Ye see a terror, and are afraid.

verses.he: הֲ‍ֽכִי־אָ֭מַרְתִּי הָ֣בוּ לִ֑י וּ֝מִכֹּחֲכֶ֗ם שִׁחֲד֥וּ בַעֲדִֽי׃
verses.en: Did I say: ‘Give unto me’? Or: ‘Offer a present for me of your substance’?

verses.he: וּמַלְּט֥וּנִי מִיַּד־צָ֑ר וּמִיַּ֖ד עָרִיצִ֣ים תִּפְדּֽוּנִי׃
verses.en: or: ‘Deliver me from the adversary’s hand’? Or: ‘Redeem me from the hand of the oppressors’?

verses.he: ה֭וֹרוּנִי וַאֲנִ֣י אַחֲרִ֑ישׁ וּמַה־שָּׁ֝גִ֗יתִי הָבִ֥ינוּ לִֽי׃
verses.en: Teach me, and I will hold my peace; And cause me to understand wherein I have erred.

verses.he: מַה־נִּמְרְצ֥וּ אִמְרֵי־יֹ֑שֶׁר וּמַה־יּוֹכִ֖יחַ הוֹכֵ֣חַ מִכֶּֽם׃
verses.en: How forcible are words of uprightness! But what doth your arguing argue?

verses.he: הַלְהוֹכַ֣ח מִלִּ֣ים תַּחְשֹׁ֑בוּ וּ֝לְר֗וּחַ אִמְרֵ֥י נֹאָֽשׁ׃
verses.en: Do ye hold words to be an argument, But the speeches of one that is desperate to be wind?

verses.he: אַף־עַל־יָת֥וֹם תַּפִּ֑ילוּ וְ֝תִכְר֗וּ עַל־רֵֽיעֲכֶֽם׃
verses.en: Yea, ye would cast lots upon the fatherless, And dig a pit for your friend.

verses.he: וְ֭עַתָּה הוֹאִ֣ילוּ פְנוּ־בִ֑י וְעַל־פְּ֝נֵיכֶ֗ם אִם־אֲכַזֵּֽב׃
verses.en: Now therefore be pleased to look upon me; For surely I shall not lie to your face.

verses.he: שֻֽׁבוּ־נָ֭א אַל־תְּהִ֣י עַוְלָ֑ה ושבי [וְשׁ֥וּבוּ] ע֝וֹד צִדְקִי־בָֽהּ׃
verses.en: Return, I pray you, let there be no injustice; Yea, return again, my cause is righteous.

verses.he: הֲיֵשׁ־בִּלְשׁוֹנִ֥י עַוְלָ֑ה אִם־חִ֝כִּ֗י לֹא־יָבִ֥ין הַוּֽוֹת׃
verses.en: Is there injustice on my tongue? Cannot my taste discern crafty devices?
